punctuation: Unicode punctuation/symbol elements separate tokens and are not symbols
abbreviations: select expan branch; never infer an expansion absent from TEI
editorial_markup: exclude note/fw/label/toc/del; retain readable supplied/sic/unclear/add text
line_break_no: split surface token at the physical line boundary; no cross-line adjacency is invented
tokenization: maximal non-whitespace, non-punctuation, non-symbol Unicode runs
symbols: ordered Unicode rune sequence of normalized token
unsupported_constructs: hard error; audited conversion reports zero
